<thought>Using the high‑resolution ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 182.073165. The M+1 isotopic peak is ~14 % of the base peak, which corresponds to ~13 carbon atoms (13 × 1.1 % ≈ 14 %). A formula with 13 carbons that matches the exact mass is C₁₃H₁₀O (13 × 12.0000 + 10 × 1.007825 + 1 × 15.994915 = 182.073165 Da). This fits both the monoisotopic mass and the isotopic pattern. Hence the molecular formula of the compound is C13H10O.</thought>
<final_answer>C13H10O</final_answer>
